name: event_balance
description: eventBus.emit('X') without matching eventBus.on('X', ...) somewhere in the codebase
source: Section 3.2 Direction 3 — 集成链路强制检查 #2: 事件 payload 语义
rationale: Tower Stack 3D fatal bug: emit('game:over') sent payload that no subscriber consumed, causing UI to never update. The 'form compliance trap' produces emit() calls but skips the matching on() handlers.
